name: Memory Note
description: Save an important fact to your long-term memory so you can find it again in future conversations. Notes go to the '## Notes' index of your memory, visible in every future session and kept longer than automatic summaries. Use it for stable facts, preferences and decisions - not for chit-chat. Only works for agents with memory enabled.

content.description: The fact to remember, written so it is understandable on its own
